[Posted on June 9, 2015](https://sciencebookaday.com/2015/06/09/jeff-vandermeer-wins-the-2014-nebula-award-for-best-novel/ "11:00 am")
[jeff-vandermeer](https://sciencebookaday.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/jeff-vandermeer.jpg)

The book takes place in a dystopic future, where expeditions into Area X have led to death, murder and worse. His first part of the Southern Reach Trilogy is about the 12th expedition.
